name: Viszló (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Viszló: a crowned blue shield with a white tree and a patriarchal cross on a green mound, between ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed VISZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Viszló arms with crown, grain and scroll
